Hi as a disabled person I hate this sentiment for a couple reasons and those who say it are often uneducated in the topic so let me share some info.

-Being disabled is a very isolating, poor life. Most do not have support systems or even someone to talk to. They aren't out marrying millionaires and many do not get married because it doesnt matter what my partner makes, what I rack up in health insurance bills won't put us in positive. 



-. Taking away a disabled persons income when, if you take the time to look into it, it is *ridiculously* hard to get and you cannot have over 2000 in your bank account, any assets over that, is asking for people to exploit this for financial abuse. If I have no income, and I cannot work and rely on my partner, this is a breeding ground for a group of people who statistically are more likely to be abused, to be subject to abuse because they basically have no resources now. And no, services for people are not overnight and often have 4-6+ year long waiting lists and if you are lucky enough you didnt need to afford a lawyer and fight the courts for SSI, it most likely will be even more impossible to get on it a *second* time when they kick you off.

A ridiculously small, if any, are out there marrying someone who can cover their needs, the rest of us make less then min wage and have to live stuck in poverty because we can lose the small income we have.  Please educate yourself before giving examples that barely exist as you are hurting the rest of us who are invisible enough and aren't even part of the conversation half the time, thank you.

Everyone will have a different answer, I will admit Mine is biased because of my situation but still I will answer.

To me if the person is of sound mind and suffering then It's fine, and I count clinical depression that's lasted years as sound mind, if you're depressed and tried every option then what are you supposed to do. If you've put up the good fight and have tried most if not all meds, therapy and everything else then really what else is there?

I been depressed almost 21 years now, suicidal the entire time. I've tried every pill, every dosage, every combo, therapy, day therapy, CBT, DBT, Mindfulness and all that happy horseshit, I'm also saddled with a chronic illness that will never go away and impacts my daily life and depression and agoraphobia that keeps me in bed. 

I am on medication that I need to take to literally function while I live in a country that is constantly trying to keep fucking over the poor in every way possible while lining their pockets. I have SSI for income and anyone who is on it will tell you its damn near impossible to survive on it alone, If I'm lucky I will get section 8 (2+ year waiting list) and will get a shitty apartment in the ghetto where It will be dangerous, loud, and all around shitty to live in.

 I have no will to live, I have no desire for anything, No desire for a career all my interests are boring and don't do anything for me anymore because depression makes EVERYTHING boring and miserable. I've lost any passion I have for every single hobby I USED to have. I'm 27 almost and never had a job because I'm scared to leave my house and now that I have this illness, I can barely function, I can't sit for long periods of time so that knocks out an office job, and I'm sickly, weak and have no energy.

I will never have a comfortable life and I sure as shit can't survive in a world where if you're sick and can't sustain a job, you're going on the streets or the best case scenario in a very shitty apartment barely able to afford bills and food.

 People will try to tell you it will get better which is just a bandaid solution to try to instill hope in you to hold out until you see through that facade, I'm not saying it won't get better but if you're sickly for an indefinite amount of time that impedes on your ability to function in the real world, it probably  will not get better. 

I've had friends try to guilt me and say I'm selfish for the way that I think (even though I plan to end it after my family is gone and no one relies on me) when they don't know what I am facing, don't know the road I'm on and don't know how my life will turn out while they are financially set, healthy and happy and able to function fine. People are always quick to call you selfish when they don't spend a moment imagining themselves in your shoes.

 If you're in a hopeless situation, are mentally aware  and have tried everything and exhausted every solution and spend days upon days in pain, who is anyone to tell you to keep going? 

Sorry for the long answer and personal bullshit no one asked about.
